contexts.text: Certain animals... have as it were two subsidiary brains within the orbits...
The truths with Angels, Spirits, and men are subsidiary lights; but they have their light from the Divine truth...
The heat of the body is excited by the heat of its spirit, and bears subsidiary aid to it.
The natural sun [acts] through the influx of spiritual heat, to which it renders subsidiary aid. DLW 106. DLW 153:end.
As the subsidiary life of the body depends on the heart alone.
(They said) that conjugial love is heat, which becomes potency if the subsidiary heat of the sun is added to it.
The malignant character of the atmosphere appears to be... a subsidiary cause.
In Heaven... things come into existence through the forces of light and heat from the Sun... without subsidiary and auxiliary forces through light and heat from the sun...
3. To which the light and heat of the sun bears subsidiary aid.
